sourceVerification: All 18 build-input files were fetched at the exact source commit and matched the local source hashes. The packaged file hash was rechecked after native testing.

nativeRequestStateAcceptance.scope: Actual Roblox client/server requests with scripted positioning; all twelve clues, incorrect-answer feedback, pause/resume assistance, distinct rewards, idempotent duplicate requests, visibly equipped outfits and world restoration. Not physical input.

simulatedInputAndWalking.scope: Actual GuiButton.Activated signals driven by VirtualInput, E-key proximity interaction, all twelve replay answers, hint button, menus, dress-up and journal. Walking used Humanoid.MoveTo; the harness positioned scrolling to reveal buttons. Not physical-device input.

skillsPracticed: addition within 100 with tens/ones representations and regrouping
gameContent.sourceLabel: Original sample practice - not current homework
gameContent.learningLimits: Counts distinguish first-try independent answers from hints/retries. Replays do not create new learning credit. This is not evidence of a child's mastery or retention.

shortcutAction: Opens the exact local .rbxlx in Roblox Studio; press F5 to play.
studioPersistence: Session-only; progress does not survive stopping the test server.
